time.description: Timestamp of the data record in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) with 30-minute intervals

R-101_Length.description: Reactor R-101 length (input parameter). This is the length of reactor R-101, one of the five surveyed operating parameters (operating parameters). It will impact the MeAce output flow, the carbon yield (C-yield), and the total cost (C-SEC)

R-101_Temperature.description: Reactor R-101 temperature (input parameter). This is the temperature of reactor R-101, one of the five surveyed operating parameters (operating parameters). It will impact the MeAce output flow, the carbon yield (C-yield), and the total cost (C-SEC)

Splitter_17_Split factors_1.description: Splitter recycle ratio - fraction of flow recycled back (input parameter). This is the splitter recycle ratio, one of the five surveyed operating parameters (operating parameters). It will impact the MeAce output flow, the carbon yield (C-yield), and the total cost (C-SEC)

K-101_Pressure.description: Reactor operating pressure set by compressor K-101 (input parameter). This is the operating pressure set by compressor K-101, one of the five surveyed operating parameters (operating parameters). It will impact the MeAce output flow, the carbon yield (C-yield), and the total cost (C-SEC)

CO_molarFlow.description: Molar flow rate of carbon monoxide (CO) feed input (input parameter). This is the molar flow rate of supplied CO gas, the feed for stream CO, and one of the five surveyed operating parameters (operating parameters). It will impact the MeAce output flow, the carbon yield (C-yield), and the total cost (C-SEC)

E-101_Heat duty.description: Heat duty of heat exchanger E-101. This is the thermal energy duty of E-101 (HeaterCooler). It increases the temperature of stream 42 to produce stream 2 at 372 K. This unit operates as a heater.
E-101_Heat duty.note: Because E-101 is a heater, its heat duty is positive since it supplies thermal energy to the process.

E-102_Heat duty.description: Heat duty of heat exchanger E-102. This is the thermal energy duty of E-102 (HeaterCooler). It decreases the temperature of stream 5 to produce stream 6 at 300 K. This unit operates as a cooler.
E-102_Heat duty.note: Because E-102 is a cooler, its heat duty is negative since it removes thermal energy from the process.

V-101_Pressure.description: Pressure in vessel V-101. This is the pressure in flash vessel V-101, where vapor-liquid flash separation occurs.

C-101_Temperature profile_all.description: Temperature profile of 17 elements in distillation column C-101, represented as a text string of semicolon-separated temperature values.

C-101_Pressure profile_all.description: Pressure profile of 17 elements in distillation column C-101, represented as a text string of semicolon-separated pressure values.

C-101_Duties profile_all.description: Energy duties of 17 elements in distillation column C-101, represented as a text string of semicolon-separated duty values.
C-101_Duties profile_all.note: The first element is negative duty (represents a cooler) and the 17th element is positive duty (represents a reboiler).

K-103_Pressure increase.description: Pressure increase across compressor K-103. The inlet stream is LP Recycle and the outlet stream is stream 11.

K-103_Pressure.note: This value is equal to the pressure of compressor K-101.

K-103_Ideal (isentropic) energy demand.description: Ideal isentropic energy demand of compressor K-103

K-102_Pressure increase.description: Pressure increase across compressor K-102. The inlet stream is HP Recycle and the outlet stream is stream 14.

K-102_Pressure.description: Pressure of compressor K-102, with HP Recycle as inlet stream and stream 14 as outlet stream.
K-102_Pressure.note: This value is equal to the pressure of compressor K-101.

K-102_Ideal (isentropic) energy demand.description: Ideal isentropic energy demand of compressor K-102

K-101_Pressure increase.description: Pressure increase across compressor K-101. The inlet stream is CO and the outlet stream is stream 16.

K-101_Ideal (isentropic) energy demand.description: Ideal isentropic energy demand of compressor K-101

K-104_Pressure increase.description: Pressure increase across compressor K-104. The inlet stream is DME and the outlet stream is stream 42.

K-104_Pressure.description: Pressure of compressor K-104, with DME as inlet stream and stream 42 as outlet stream.

K-104_Ideal (isentropic) energy demand.description: Ideal isentropic energy demand of compressor K-104

total_energy_demand.description: Total energy demand = sum of K-101 to K-104 energy consumption. This is the total compressor energy usage in the production process and one of the target objectives for energy cost.
total_energy_demand.note: Equal to the sum of energy demand from the four compressors: K-101, K-102, K-103, and K-104.

carbon_efficiency.description: c-yield is the carbon conversion efficiency. This is an important metric for evaluating process performance and one of the target objectives.

specific_energy_consumption_meAce.description: Energy consumption per mole of methyl acetate product. This is an important metric for evaluating process energy efficiency and one of the target objectives for unit energy cost.
